Explain briefly and make a falsifiable prediction. Return exactly one JSON object, without markdown or text outside it. The mapping.source_id field is a bibliography CARD identifier, independent of the predictive representation. Its only legal values are storage, transport, saturation, external_clock, none. Representation names such as memory_slow, memory_multiscale, memory_clock and state_cubic are NOT card identifiers and are invalid in mapping.source_id. Copy one exact card id only when its relation is supported; use none when no card is justified. Do not invent an identifier.
